description: Create an IDPHANTOM payment quote with transparent platform fee (0.5%, min $0.01 USDC). Returns a payment intent ready for the payer's EIP-712 signature. Free: quoting never moves funds.

amount.description: Token amount in smallest units (6 decimals for USDC), e.g. '2500000' = $2.50.

asset_contract.description: ERC-20 token contract to pay with, e.g. USDC on Base: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913.

idempotency_key.description: Unique client-generated key; safe retries return the same quote instead of duplicating it.

metadata.description: Optional free-form key/value object attached to the quote (surfaced in receipts).

payer_agent_id.description: Optional A2A agent card ID of the payer, for discovery and audit.

payer_wallet.description: EVM address of the payer wallet (0x..., checksummed).

recipient_agent_id.description: Optional A2A agent card ID of the recipient.

recipient_wallet.description: EVM address of the recipient wallet (0x...).

name: quote_payment

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.

title: Quote a payment
